videos.headline: Jackson soars for block to set up Clingan's alley-oop slam
videos.description: UConn's Andre Jackson skies for a big-time block, and Donovan Clingan throws down an alley-oop on the other end.

videos.headline: UConn's Adama Sanogo elevates for big block
videos.description: UConn big man Adama Sanogo rises up for a big rejection vs. Florida.

videos.headline: Andre Jackson hits early 3 for UConn
videos.description: Andre Jackson makes Florida pay for leaving him wide open beyond the arc.

videos.headline: Donovan Clingan flushes it home for UConn
videos.description: UConn freshman Donovan Clingan finishes strong with a two-handed slam vs. Florida.

videos.headline: Florida's Jason Jitoboh signals 'too small' after scoring down low
videos.description: Jason Jitoboh scores against Donovan Clingan and lets him know about it.

videos.headline: Adama Sanogo scores for UConn with fancy footwork
videos.description: UConn extends its lead as Adama Sanogo shows off his skills in the paint.

videos.headline: Donovan Clingan swats shot out of bounds
videos.description: UConn big man Donovan Clingan denies Florida's Colin Castleton with a big block.

videos.headline: Alex Fudge rocks the rim for Florida
videos.description: Alex Fudge drives down the lane and throws down a powerful one-handed jam for the Gators.

videos.headline: Jordan Hawkins buries tough jumper for UConn
videos.description: UConn's Jordan Hawkins comes off a screen and knocks down a contested jump shot.

news.headline: Judge grants injunction for Denzel Aberdeen to play for Florida
news.description: Guard Denzel Aberdeen, who is projected to start for preseason No. 1 Florida, was granted a temporary injunction to play for the Gators this season.
